verdict.rationale: Unity runs cloud services (Gaming Services such as Cloud Save, AI Assistant credits, Build Automation), so choosing a data region is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents region or residency selection. UGS environments are logical partitions for testing, staging and production, not geographic storage choices, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
